definitions.explanation: A board displaying information, often a shop name or advertisement.
A person or thing that represents or symbolizes something.
Used in expressions referring to the end of business hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{看板|かんばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しく→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{看板|かんばん}⟦{女優|じょゆう}→女優：03353_joyuu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
{看板|かんばん} has multiple meanings related to representation and display.

Common expressions:
- {看板|かんばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put up a sign; to open for business)
- {看板|かんばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧ (to close down a business)
- {看板|かんばん}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ (flagship product)
- {看板|かんばん}⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧/{看板|かんばん}⟦{女優|じょゆう}→女優：03353_joyuu⟧ (poster girl/leading actress)
- {看板|かんばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{偽|いつわ}り→偽り：09999_itsuwari⟧⟦なし→無し：03779_nashi⟧ (truth in advertising)

Business/manufacturing:
- かんばん⟦{方式|ほうしき}→方式：05454_houshiki⟧ (Kanban system - Toyota's just-in-time manufacturing method)

Note on closing time:
- {看板|かんばん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (It's closing time - from the practice of taking down signs at closing)
